==Description==
This template may be used to cite [[w:c:fornite:Cosmetic Items|cosmetic items]] from ''[[Fortnite]]''.

==Instructions==
<code><nowiki>{{FortniteCite|xxxxxxxxx}}</nowiki></code>

Fill the empty parameter with a relevant cosmetic item from the game. When the parameter is filled in correctly, a pipelink to the appropriate article on [[w:c:fortnite|Fortnite Wiki]] should appear.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{FortniteCite|Nalargon Keytar}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{FortniteCite|Nalargon Keytar}}
